title: Sheinbaum Calls “Absurd” the PT’s Claim of U.S. Pressure in Morena
author: Anahí Del Ángel
content:
_This article by[Anahí Del Ángel](https://contralinea.com.mx/author/anahida/)
originally appeared in the [October 8, 2026 edition of
Contralínea](https://contralinea.com.mx/interno/semana/sheinbaum-califica-de-
absurdo-senalamiento-del-pt-sobre-presiones-de-eu-en-morena/), an
investigative Mexican news outlet._

President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo called **" absurd" and baseless** the claim
by the national leader of the Labor Party, Alberto Anaya Gutiérrez, about
alleged pressure from the United States in the designation of Morena's state
coordinators ahead of the 2027 elections.

During her morning press conference this October 8, the president rejected the
interpretation of the leader of the Labor Party (PT) and maintained that **the
designations respond to Morena 's internal mechanism**. "It is an absurdity,
really, what he is saying has no basis whatsoever," she stated.

Sheinbaum Pardo recalled that since its founding Morena established polls as
the mechanism to choose its coordinators, although she acknowledged that the
procedures of any political party can be improved.

> Morena, from its formation, made the decision that the coordinators would be
> chosen by poll, and well, it is the result of the polls.
>
> President Claudia Sheinbaum

Likewise, she considered that the versions about a supposed intervention by
the United States may arise from disagreements with the results of the
internal process: "There are times when the person that one of the political
parties or another person would have wanted does not come out in the poll, and
they make these interpretations that have no basis whatsoever."

The PT leader's claims come ahead of the 2027 elections, when **17
governorships, the Chamber of Deputies and various local offices** will be
renewed. In that context, Morena designated state coordinators as part of its
political organization and the preparation of its territorial structures.
